notes.title: DunkRatz wins Best in Show at SFGE2019 and gets a new release date!
notes.notes:
We had a fantastic time at the Southern Fried Gaming Expo this past weekend and met a lot of very friendly fans and fellow Indie Developers. It is a huge honor to have DunkRatz win Best in Show there. We'd also like to congratulate Red Ink Inc for their game Parallel also winning Best in Show. And of course a huge shout-out to all the other awesome Indie Devs at the show that we got to meet. It was a blast!

It was so cool to see people discover the game and come back to the booth again and again to keep playing the game. We got a ton of great positive feedback on the game and ultimately made the decision to push the release date back a little bit to [b]September 4th [/b] to give us some extra time to squash some new bugs we found and polish up the whole experience with some nice quality of life improvements that we all on the team agreed the game should have before being made available for everyone to download. 

We love DunkRatz and can't wait to make it as good as possible and share it with you all. 

In the meantime please follow us on twitter @pinkhousegames to stay up-to-date on the game's development. Thanks for following DunkRatz!
